career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「高压下的职业倦怠」——专业、有方法、有支持的老师，才能长期干下去。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「编制有限与工作强度」：特教老师编制少、压力大、流失率高，且 AI 正在辅助课件与记录环节；但课堂管理、情绪疏导和 IEP 落地，短期离不开专业教师，特教师资长期短缺。
risks: 工作强度大，情绪消耗高，流失率高
编制有限，待遇地区差异大
家校沟通压力与责任并重
AI 辅助文书，但专业门槛没降低
融合教育推进中，基层支持资源不足

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能帮你生成分层教案、整理 IEP 记录，但孩子情绪上来的那一瞬间、那一声「老师我不会」背后的沮丧——还得你蹲下来接住。特殊孩子的人生路难走，有你陪着，他就多一份光亮。

responsibilities: 制定执行个别化教育计划
开展分层次教学与训练

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest career risk is not AI, but exhaustion. Therapists also perform emotionally intensive work and need care themselves.
career_risk_cards.fact: The greatest occupational risk is not AI, but exhaustion and workload. Cases follow one after another, every session requires complete focus, documentation demands are heavy, and slow patient recovery and anxious families create considerable psychological pressure.
risks: High case density with heavy cognitive and emotional demands
Heavy documentation and reporting burden
Slow patient recovery can cause frustration
High professional entry barriers and a long training period
Compensation varies widely among organizations

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI can produce assessments, generate exercises, and guide pronunciation practice, but when a person with aphasia says Mom again, the therapist is still the one beside them.

responsibilities: Assess speech, language, and swallowing functions
Provide rehabilitation therapy and track progress
skills: Speech and language assessment and diagnosis

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI，而是「耗竭」——治疗师也是在情感上高强度输出的人，同样需要被照顾。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位最大的风险不是 AI，而是「耗竭与负荷」——个案一个接一个、每节课都要全神贯注，书写任务重，面对恢复缓慢的患者和焦虑的家属，心理压力不小。
risks: 个案密度大，脑力与情绪消耗高
书写与报告负担重
恢复缓慢的患者带来挫败感
执业门槛高，培养周期长
机构间待遇差异大

page.contract_project_risk_block: AI 能出评估、生成练习、陪练发音，但让一个失语的人重新喊出「妈」的那一瞬间，陪在旁边的还是治疗师。

responsibilities: 评估言语语言吞咽功能

career_risk_cards.callout: The greatest immediate career risk is not AI, but condition monitoring + drones. Systems absorb standard inspections, while people who replace components and make sound judgments become more secure.
career_risk_cards.fact: Occupational risk comes from condition monitoring and remote diagnostics. Systems replace standard inspections, but component replacement at height, on-site decisions, and emergency repairs remain difficult to automate.
risks: Condition monitoring absorbs inspections
Replaced by remote diagnostics
Drones replace walking inspections
Work-at-height risks
Pressure to update skills

page.contract_project_risk_block: No matter how intelligent systems become, technicians still decide which blade needs replacement, how to act at height, and how to handle emergency repairs. Ultimately, people must think, replace parts, and inspect because the human role cannot be removed from turbine maintenance.

career_risk_cards.callout: 最大的职业风险不是 AI 当下，而是「状态监测 + 无人机」——标准巡检被系统吃，能换件、会判断的人反而更稳。
career_risk_cards.fact: 岗位风险来自状态监测与远程诊断；标准巡检被系统替代，但高空换件、现场决断与应急抢修仍难替代。
risks: 状态监测吃巡检
远程诊断替代
无人机替走查
高空作业风险
技能更新压力

page.contract_project_risk_block: 不管系统多聪明，哪片叶要换、怎么高空决断、突发怎么抢修，最后还是技术员的脑去想、手去换、眼去查——风机这头，人撤不干净。
